title: Judge input row
description: One signal, as written by `python -m pipeline.ingest` (add --classify for IQ recordings). One JSON object per line. Extra fields are allowed and ignored.

id.description: Row number. Ingest sets it; the Judge numbers rows itself when it is missing.

signal_class.description: From `ingest --classify` (IQ only). Missing means not classified, which is judged white.

hopping.description: IQ bursts: the centre moves from pulse to pulse. Used by the wifi-hopping rule.

noise_floor_db.description: Sweep rows only. Used by the jamming check.

first_seen.description: Sweep rows: local time with no zone, e.g. 2026-11-14T10:30:00. Used to place the signal on a GPS track.

start_s.description: IQ rows: seconds after the capture began. Used with --capture-start to place the signal on a GPS track.
